# File to download data
This script downloads the required dataset from the course repository and saves it directly to the `data/raw` folder.
## Download link
```{r}
# Detect correct path relative to working directory
if (basename(getwd()) == "src") {
  target_dir <- "../data/raw"
  file_path <- "../data/raw/video_view.csv"
} else {
  target_dir <- "data/raw"
  file_path <- "data/raw/video_view.csv"
}

# Creates the map if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(target_dir)) {
  dir.create(target_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Creates the data file if it does not exist
if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hannesdatta/course-dprep/refs/heads/main/material/project/video_view.csv"
  download.file(data_url, destfile = file_path, mode = "wb")
  message("Dataset downloaded successfully into data/raw/.")
} else {
  message("Dataset already exists in data/raw/. Skipping download.")
}
```
